messages:
Maya Chen: Quick question — we need a concrete onboarding pipeline for new models. Proposing: (1) smoke sanity (load + tokens produce), (2) bench (latency/throughput/mem), (3) eval set pass/fail, (4) compat checks (KV cache, quantized kernels). Thoughts?
Samir Patel: +1. Need to be explicit about pass thresholds. e.g., p95 latency < 120ms for 2k context on dedicated xlarge.
Kai Nguyen: Can we avoid hard numbers in repo? Maybe per-model profile. But CI should enforce relative regressions.
Ava Li: Agree — baseline per model. Also add 'no silent fallback' check: model must expose deterministic decision for fallback params.
Maya Chen: Good call. For benchmarks, let's run: (a) synthetic microbench for kernel-level perf, (b) end-to-end qps/latency with realistic prompt distributions, (c) memory highwater. CI jobs -> `onboard/bench-latency`, `onboard/bench-throughput`, `onboard/bench-mem`.
Samir Patel: For compatibility: check ops used vs supported kernels. We'll have a compatibility matrix: arch -> quant -> kernels. Add a `compat-check` that parses model graph and runs `ops-checker`.
DevOps Bot: CI triggered: `onboard/bench-latency` for model `redwood-alpha-7b` by @Maya Chen
Kai Nguyen: Quantization: we need weighted accuracy checks after 4-bit/8-bit conversion. Add eval on 3 dev tasks and threshold per task.
Ava Li: Also add an inference smoke on Dedicated/Dedicated-fallback path — ensures routing policies don't break for pinned versions.
Samir Patel: Edge-case: models that rely on custom ops. If custom op found, fail CI and route to manual review with checklist.
Maya Chen: Decision proposal: automated pipeline will produce artifact `onboard/<model>/report.json` with fields: `benchmarks`, `compat_issues`, `eval_scores`, `ci_status`. If compat issues => fail and attach repro.
Kai Nguyen: Implementation notes: reuse `ops-checker` from eng-runtime, add a lightweight runner in k8s job with GPU selector, ensure image includes same kernels as prod.
Ava Li: Action items: Samir to draft compat matrix doc, Kai to wirebench jobs, Maya to update onboarding PR template. I'll own manual-review playbook.
Samir Patel: I'll add thresholds and a sample `report.json` schema in the PR by EOD.
Maya Chen: Cool. If no objections I'll put an RFC follow-up with these concrete checks and CI job names.
Kai Nguyen: +1. Also logging: ensure bench artifacts (profiles + perf traces) are uploaded to S3 with retention 90 days.
Ava Li: And add a smoke eval that runs a deterministic sample prompt to detect tokenization/model tokenizer mismatches.
Samir Patel: Noted. We should add a small opt-in step for 'fast-track' for known models (whitelisted) that skips manual review.
Maya Chen: OK thanks team. I'll open the RFC followup and ping infra for runner images. :thumbsup:
